verdict.rationale: Highnote documents collaborative authorization, which lets your system approve or decline each transaction in real time. That covers the 'my system approves each authorization' half of just-in-time funding. Financial accounts and an integrated ledger suggest balance-based programs, but nothing in the pack says funding is pushed at authorization time, names a prefunded mode, or offers a choice between models. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of prefunded vs just-in-time funding models, a mechanism for funding each authorization rather than only approving it, documented cash-flow tradeoffs between the models, independent corroboration.
